thread:
DeployBot: Starting rollout v5.6.0 -> canary 20% (us-west3, eu2). Post-deploy smoke suite triggered: smoke-4812345678.
Carla: Kicking off cold-host synthetic and e2e userflow. Will post failures here.
SmokeBot: smoke-suite batch-1 finished. eu2 cold path: 7 failures, 3 rate-limit (429), 4 timeouts. ids: s-2001..s-2007.
Omar: Hm 429s on cold hosts are odd. Any quota changes?
InfraBot: No quota changes scheduled. Noting that short window maintenance on eu2 load-balancers started at 4812345600 (scheduled). Possible correlation.
Priya: Checking proxy logs — we see a burst of 429s hitting the shared auth service during the maintenance window. Token refresh calls queued causing head-of-line blocking for cold-host requests.
Carla: So these are not model regressions. Should we pause rollout and pin eu2 back to v5.5.9 until maintenance ends?
Ravi: Recommend hold rollout globally at 20%, pin eu2 to previous stable, and re-run smokes after maintenance completes + 10m warm period. Also file ENG-4490 to decouple auth refresh from probe path.
Omar: Agree with pin. @DeployBot can you run pin? Example: `deployctl pin --region eu2 --version v5.5.9 --reason "auth-maintenance-induced-429s"`
DeployBot: eu2 pinned -> v5.5.9 (pin-id pin-4812). Traffic migrated.
SmokeBot: re-run smoke-suite batch-2 against eu2: 0 429s, 1 timeout on a cold-host prefill, p95 overall unchanged.
Priya: That single timeout looks like usual KV prefill jitter. Adding a transient tolerance to smoke-runner to avoid maintenance false positives.
Carla: Leaving canary at 20% with eu2 pinned. Will continue monitor for 30m then consider 40% ramp if no alarms. Drafting release note: "v5.6.0: routing optimization + small perf gains. eu2 temporarily pinned due to infra maintenance interaction; follow-up ENG-4490."
Ravi: Created ENG-4490 and assigned to infra-auth team. Added link: https://redwood.local/eng/ENG-4490.
InfraBot: verifier-summary: PASS with region-pin action. Recommendation: proceed after maintenance window and successful post-maintenance smoke-run.
Carla: Thanks team. Posting final status in 30m. :white_check_mark:
